source.name: Google Play
source.note: Public Google Play metadata snapshot, country MA and language en. A selection of 50 apps and 50 games discovered on the Morocco apps/games storefront, not the full store or an independently verified ranking. featuredIds and bestIds retain storefront discovery order within each kind. newAppIds/newGameIds sort the selected entries by their original release date, not update date. Ratings are rounded to two decimals. Download links open official Google Play listings. At most 12 store screenshots per entry. Summaries are brief excerpts. Update dates without a public timestamp are normalized to UTC midnight. Size and any unavailable fields or local icon assets are empty; no APK files were downloaded. The reference ads object is preserved.
